For a non-horizontal line of slope \(m\), write \(x=-3/2+t,\ y=mt\). Substitution gives \(m^2t^2=-6(-3/2+t)=9-6t\), i.e. \(m^2t^2+6t-9=0\). If the roots are \(t_1,t_2\), then \(|MN|=|t_2-t_1|\sqrt{1+m^2}\). Also \(|t_2-t_1|=\sqrt{(6/m^2)^2+36/m^2}=6\sqrt{1+m^2}/m^2\), so \(|MN|=6(1+m^2)/m^2=6+6/m^2>6\). The vertical line through \(F\), \(x=-3/2\), meets the parabola at \(y=\pm3\), giving distance \(6\). Therefore the minimum is \(\boxed{6}\).
